criteria.evidence: src/domain/market-state.ts decodeMarketFrame routes JSON and bounded MessagePack inputs through the same application-owned market-event schema boundary. MessagePack decoding enforces byte, string, binary, array, map, extension, nesting, and message-count bounds; controls are constrained and mixed control/data frames are rejected. tests/market-state.test.ts exercises equivalent normalization and malformed/unsupported inputs.

tests/market-state.test.ts loads fixtures/market/msgpack/{batch,connected,subscription,error}.bin and asserts normalized events and singleton controls. It also asserts malformed, oversized, too-deep, mixed, wrong-type, and over-count rejection. Candidate-bound focused-msgpack-wired and offline-msgpack-wired checks both record PASS (exit code 0).

src/main.ts imports and calls createConfiguredAlpacaMarketStream(config, ...). The configured factory in src/infra/alpaca-market-stream.ts maps config.alpacaMarketDataCodec into the stream's codec option, which controls both Content-Type and binary/text frame handling. tests/alpaca-market-stream.test.ts tests that factory using msgpack application configuration, observes the application/msgpack request header, feeds binary success/authentication/subscription frames, and asserts connected status with no invalid frames.

limitations: No credentialed live Alpaca stream session was performed; this review verifies deterministic local implementation and test evidence, not live provider qualification.
